name: @sparx/operator
description: Dependency-free operator contracts for the WizeWorks admin console (docs/apps/admin/build-plan.md): the capability vocabulary (D5), the named-role capability bundles, and the typed api-rest /internal/operator/* client (D6). Importable by apps/admin, @sparx/operator-auth, and services/api-rest without pulling in Better Auth or a DB client.
